lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four distinct horizontal rows, with inter-spot distance increasing slightly towards the posterior region of the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like structure of anchor nodes in the mid-lateral field.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient characterized by high luminance on the upper edge and distinct shadowing immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of approximately 10-15 high-luminance spots, primarily concentrated in the posterior and basal regions of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an elongated, high-contrast silhouette consistent with a remora attached to the ventral-lateral region posterior to the pectoral fin.
